propositions: The import-linter job in _optionality.yml consumes one concurrent slot but provides redundant coverage because its test files are already collected by all four test matrix cells (3.11/3.12/3.13 + macOS) in _build-and-test.yml
Deleting the import-linter job creates a gap where no explicit check verifies the two test files remain collected under the default suite selection (no integration/external markers)

A durable test must be added to assert tests/unit/test_core_optionality.py and tests/unit/test_optional.py collect exactly 9 items under '-m not integration and not external' to guard against future marker additions or path changes

The three tests within the deleted job (test_lean_workflow_runtime_pulls_no_heavy_stack, test_no_core_module_imports_heavy_stack_at_module_scope, test_blocked_extra_degrades_friendly) do not require a loaded worker process to function correctly
Gerrit Verified runs exceed the GitHub Free org-wide cap of 20 concurrent job slots with _optionality.yml contributing 8 of them, necessitating the removal of non-unique work
